temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual; when Jose asks, she says it is personal stuff and thanks him, appreciating his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose sees Patricia as normally vibrant and has no specific concern about her well-being.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His impression shifts from no specific concern to suspicion that something personal is troubling her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be dealing with a personal problem, but she is not ready to share details and appreciates supportive offers.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available to listen and support Patricia without pressuring her to disclose more.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; afterward she confirms she is overwhelmed by bills and is open to discussing financial planning or budgeting.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia has an unspecified personal issue and appreciates his support, but Jose does not know the cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His general concern becomes specific: financial stress is a concrete problem, and she may accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is under financial pressure and is receptive to budgeting or financial planning help when she feels ready.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, empathy, and a wish to be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer financial planning or budgeting support and wait for her to take him up on it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that he was not prying, says she is grateful for his offer, and values having someone to turn to.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After offering financial help, Jose believes Patricia may need support but worries he may have overstepped her boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His worry is resolved by her reassurance; his support is welcome rather than intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his support and does not view his concern as prying; he can continue helping as a friend while respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Patricia as a friend and respect her privacy boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia responds politely but briefly to Jose's casual check-in, says everything is good and she is planning a quiet weekend, and thanks him when he offers to chat or help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support and that he has not overstepped, but he remains attentive to how much help she wants.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He senses she values his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern but wants privacy and to manage her own issues; Jose should remain available without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, warmth, and a mild sense of restraint.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Check in casually and offer help without prying, letting Patricia set the pace.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During continued check-ins, Patricia says she is busy but handling things, thanks Jose for checking in, and says it is great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates support but prefers privacy and is handling her issues herself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, it confirms. He sees that she is managing and values his low-pressure supportive presence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her situation and appreciates Jose's ongoing support; his role is to remain a supportive coworker without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue maintaining a supportive presence and offer low-pressure help, coffee, or conversation when needed.
